text: Engbert-Kliegl kinematics is defined only on a proved regular timestamp grid and returns Either[KinematicsError, Vector[(Instant, Vec2[Deg])]]. The implementation uses the published denominator 6 * samplePeriod, excludes every five-sample window containing Blink, Lost, OffScreen, or SampleOrigin.Interpolated support, and threshold estimation preserves sampling rejection as EkEstimationError.InvalidSampling. The streaming detector carries each classified centre's physical velocity and period into its run, so event peak velocity is the measured maximum rather than a later recomputation over truncated support. Golden values are pinned to vecvel in the University of Potsdam Python toolbox at a3eba6e9f1464c953c81fbd87944ba7678c2cf64; the generator executes only that parsed function definition and tests embed the fixture for JVM/JS.
